submitted.rationale: Of the three measured compositions, index 6 (Sb0.36Zn0.64) had the highest EQE at 2.4 eV: 0.0064%. Index 26 gave 0.0010% and index 16 gave about 0. Every phase here is a wide-gap oxide, so EQE is tiny across the library. XRD on index 4 showed a single Zn-rich phase with no trirutile peaks. Indexes 16 and 26 are Sb-rich and showed trirutile ZnSb2O6-type peaks, and they performed worse.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE about 0 (-7.6e-5%). This is at the ZnSb2O6 composition, whose gap is too wide to absorb 2.4 eV photons.
Measured EQE 0.0010%, about six times lower than index 6.
